impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (bias/gain shifts unless net027 is externally biased)

impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (main path remains; output bias/swing degrades)

impact_estimate: Low-to-high depending on external biasing (low only if net19 is sourced elsewhere)
